books.title: A Curse So Dark and Lonely
books.author: Brigid Kemmerer
books.description: A modern retelling of Beauty and the Beast. Cursed to relive the same autumn over and over, Prince Rhen's only hope lies with Harper, a girl from our world who is pulled into his. Together they must break the curse before the kingdom falls.

books.title: House of Sky and Breath
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
books.description: The second book in the Crescent City series. Bryce Quinlan and Hunt Athalar want nothing more than a quiet life, but rebels are chipping away at the Asteri's iron grip on the city, and they cannot stay out of the fight for long.

books.title: Closer to the Dead
books.author: Scott Hunter
books.description: A DCI Brendan Moran novel. When a body turns up in a quiet English village, Moran is drawn into a case where old secrets refuse to stay buried, and every lead brings him closer to danger.

books.title: Ramses the Damned
books.author: Anne Rice & Christopher Rice
books.description: The Reign of Osiris. Ramses the Great, made immortal by an ancient elixir, faces a new threat that could unravel everything he has built, in a sweeping adventure of love, power and eternal life.

books.title: A Flicker in the Dark
books.author: Stacy Willingham
books.description: When Chloe Davis was twelve, six teenage girls went missing in her small Louisiana town and her father confessed to the crimes. Twenty years later, girls start disappearing again, and Chloe must face the past she has tried so hard to escape.

books.title: The Art of Fashion Illustration
books.author: Somer Flaherty Tejwani
books.description: Learn the techniques and inspiration of today's leading fashion artists. A practical guide to drawing figures, garments and textures, with tear-out fashion silhouettes to practise on.

books.title: The Kite Runner
books.author: Khaled Hosseini
books.description: The unforgettable story of Amir and Hassan, two boys growing up in Kabul whose friendship is shattered by a single act of betrayal. Years later, Amir returns to a changed Afghanistan to find a way to be good again.

books.title: Shadow Sister
books.author: Lucinda Riley
books.description: The third book in The Seven Sisters series. Star D'Aplièse follows the clues her late father left her to a London bookshop, and into a family history that reaches back to Edwardian England.

books.title: Where the Crawdads Sing
books.author: Delia Owens
books.description: For years, rumours of the "Marsh Girl" have haunted Barkley Cove. Abandoned as a child, Kya Clark grows up alone in the North Carolina marshes, until a local man is found dead and she becomes the prime suspect.

books.title: The 1619 Project
books.author: Nikole Hannah-Jones
books.description: A new origin story. Essays, poems and fiction that place the consequences of slavery and the contributions of Black Americans at the centre of the story of the United States.

books.title: Near the Bone
books.author: Christina Henry
books.description: Mattie lives with her husband William on an isolated mountain, far from anyone who could help her. When she finds the mutilated body of a fox in the snow, she realises that something else is out there in the woods.

books.title: We Hunt the Flame
books.author: Hafsah Faizal
books.description: People lived because she killed. People died because he lived. Zafira the Hunter and Nasir the Prince of Death are sent on a perilous quest into the cursed Arz to restore magic to their dying world.

books.title: Ride the Wind
books.author: Cynthia Wildeson
books.description: A young dreamer discovers she can hear the voice of the wind itself. To save the sky kingdom she loves, she must learn to ride the storms before an ancient darkness swallows the stars.

books.title: Flame's Fury
books.author: Kathryn O'Brien
books.description: Book one of the Elemental Kingdoms. A fire-born queen fights to protect her throne as rival elements rise against her, and the fury inside her becomes both her greatest weapon and her greatest danger.

books.title: The Crimson Birds
books.author: Unknown Author
books.description: Three sisters bound by blood and a crimson curse. When the birds return to their city, they must decide whether to break the curse together or let it tear them apart.

books.title: The Elemental Mage
books.author: Nidhi Shetty
books.description: Magic of earth, water, fire and air has been lost for a thousand years, until one apprentice mage awakens all four at once and becomes the most hunted person in the realm.

books.title: The Hall of Shadows
books.author: Stefanie Saw
books.description: Book two of a dark fantasy saga. Within the endless halls of a forgotten palace, every shadow hides a secret, and some of them are hunting back.

books.title: Reign of Blood
books.author: Becca Blake
books.description: The complete trilogy. A vampire court, a stolen crown and a heroine who refuses to bow. Romance, betrayal and blood collide in a kingdom built on darkness.

books.title: The Little Grave
books.author: Carolyn Arnold
books.description: Detective Amanda Steele, book one. The smaller the town, the bigger the secrets. When a child's body is found in a shallow grave, Amanda must uncover what her quiet hometown has been hiding.

books.title: Her Final Hour
books.author: Carla Kovach
books.description: Anything can happen behind closed doors. When a woman is found dead after a night out, Detective Gina Harte races against time before the killer strikes again.

books.title: No Way Out
books.author: Cara Hunter
books.description: A DI Adam Fawley thriller. An ordinary family, apart from one thing: someone wants them dead. After a fire tears through their Oxford home, Fawley must find out who started it and why.

books.title: The Girl Next Door
books.author: Phoebe Morgan
books.description: One little lie just became deadly. When a teenage girl goes missing from a quiet village, the neighbours' secrets start to surface, and nobody is quite who they seem.

books.title: The House
books.author: Bentley Little
books.description: Five strangers, each haunted by a house from their childhood, discover that the houses are all the same, and that it has been waiting for them to come home.

books.title: From Dusk to Dawn
books.author: T. R. Tells
books.description: When the sun sets over the village, nobody goes outside. One night, a stranger arrives who has never heard the rule, and the long night between dusk and dawn begins.

books.title: Winterspell
books.author: J. R. Sorna
books.description: Every winter the snow brings a spell over the forest, and every winter someone disappears. This year, the frost has chosen a new victim, and she is determined to fight back.
